Avec son mari Kenneth, elle présente à d: With her husband Kenneth, she shows Black children two identical dolls, one white, one Black, and asks them which one is nice, which one is pretty. Most choose the white one. This work was cited in 1954 by the Supreme Court in the ruling that ended school segregation.
Pour lui, nous ne pleurons pas parce que: For him, we don't cry because we are sad: we are sad because we cry. The body reacts first, the emotion follows. At Harvard he taught the first course in experimental psychology in the United States, and noted that the first lecture on psychology he ever heard was his own.
Seul cobaye de ses propres expériences,: The only guinea pig of his own experiments, he learns thousands of nonsense syllables (textbooks cite DAX or BOK), to the beat of a metronome, and measures how fast he forgets them. This is the forgetting curve, published in 1885. This game applies it to your recalls.
Il reçoit le Nobel en 1904 pour ses trav: He received the Nobel in 1904 for his work on digestion, not for the conditioned reflex. His laboratory ran like a factory, with dozens of assistants and dogs. To announce food, he mostly used a metronome, a buzzer or a whistle, far more often than a bell.
En 1961, il fait croire à des volontaire: In 1961, he leads volunteers to believe they are sending electric shocks to a “learner” who makes mistakes. On the calm orders of a man in a gray lab coat, twenty-six out of forty go up to 450 volts. The shocks were fake. The volunteers' distress was very real.
Avec une coloration à l'argent inventée: Using a silver stain invented by his rival Golgi, he shows that the brain is made of separate cells, neurons, and draws thousands of them. They share the 1906 Nobel and contradict each other in their speeches. As a child, he had built a cannon and demolished a neighbor's gate.
Médecin des gladiateurs de Pergame, puis: Physician to the gladiators of Pergamon, then to Emperor Marcus Aurelius, he derives four temperaments from Hippocrates' four humors: sanguine, phlegmatic, choleric, melancholic. The theory is wrong, the words stayed. He dissected monkeys for lack of human bodies, and his errors stood until Vesalius.
Jeune chercheur à Montréal, maladroit, i: A clumsy young researcher in Montreal, he injects all sorts of extracts into struggling rodents, and always gets the same lesions, whatever the extract. From this he derives the concept of “stress”. He later took money from the tobacco industry, delighted that people talked about stress rather than cigarettes.
